name: Kempinski Hotel Bahia Estepona
insider_take: This palatial beachfront resort brings Old World European elegance to Spain's stunning Costa del Sol, where Andalusian charm meets Mediterranean luxury.
whats_special: The Kempinski Hotel Bahia Estepona sits on one of the few remaining undeveloped stretches of Costa del Sol coastline, offering direct access to pristine Playa del Cristo beach. The property features authentic Andalusian architecture with hand-painted tiles, Moorish courtyards, and panoramic views of the Mediterranean and Gibraltar's iconic Rock.
pro_tip: Book a sea-view suite on the upper floors for unobstructed sunrise views over Africa's coastline - on clear days, you can actually see Morocco across the Strait of Gibraltar.
dont_miss: Estepona's famous "Flower Pots Route" through the charming old town, where over 3,000 colorful planters line the white-washed streets. The nearby Selwo Aventura safari park offers a unique African experience just 15 minutes away, while Puerto Banús and Marbella's glamorous nightlife scene are within easy reach.
pros: Prime beachfront location with direct Mediterranean access
Luxury Kempinski brand standards and service excellence
Multiple dining venues with Mediterranean cuisine
cons: May be quieter than bustling resort destinations
